column3: NSLOCTEXT("", "dt_ItemTable_1259920001_ShortDesc", "A simple medicinal poultice of crushed herbs and soothing plant matter, applied directly to bruised and battered flesh.")
column4: NSLOCTEXT("", "dt_ItemTable_1259920001_LongDesc", "A thick herbal preparation made from crushed leaves, fibrous plant matter, and other soothing ingredients worked into a damp paste. Applied directly to bruised or battered flesh, the poultice helps ease tenderness, reduce swelling, and encourage the body to recover from minor trauma. Though humble compared to more advanced medicines, it remains a reliable staple among herbalists and apothecaries, particularly for treating injuries that require care rather than invasive intervention.")

column3: NSLOCTEXT("", "dt_ItemTable_1259920002_ShortDesc", "A cooling medicinal salve applied to burned skin to soothe pain and support healing.")
column4: NSLOCTEXT("", "dt_ItemTable_1259920002_LongDesc", "A smooth medicinal salve prepared from cooling herbs and carefully blended oils. When spread across burned flesh, it eases the heat and irritation of the injury while protecting the damaged skin from further aggravation. Burn Salve is a common treatment among herbalists and apothecaries, valued for its simplicity and effectiveness when dealing with burns that do not yet require more advanced medical intervention.")

column3: NSLOCTEXT("", "dt_ItemTable_1259920003_ShortDesc", "A mild restorative tonic used to ease the discomfort of withdrawal and shorten its lingering effects.")
column4: NSLOCTEXT("", "dt_ItemTable_1259920003_LongDesc", "A gently bitter herbal tonic brewed from calming plants and restorative ingredients. It does not completely remove the effects of withdrawal, but it can soften the worst of the discomfort and help the body regain its equilibrium more quickly. The tonic is commonly used as supportive care for those recovering from prolonged use of intoxicants, lotus preparations, or other habit-forming substances, allowing the symptoms to pass with considerably less distress.")

column3: NSLOCTEXT("", "dt_ItemTable_1259920004_ShortDesc", "A concentrated medicinal extract used to combat infection and support the body\'s natural resistance to illness.")
column4: NSLOCTEXT("", "dt_ItemTable_1259920004_LongDesc", "A pungent medicinal extract prepared from carefully processed mouldroot and other naturally resistant substances. Though unpleasant in scent and taste, the resulting preparation is valued for its ability to combat infection and assist the body in overcoming contaminated wounds and sickness. Herbalists and apothecaries alike prize Mouldroot Extract as one of the most dependable remedies available when ordinary cleaning and bandaging are no longer sufficient.")

column3: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "D879FB0141883CD16A3915B71F512E57", "Thick reinforced bandages designed to apply firm pressure and control active bleeding.")
column4: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "FA375A604230E4AF39626EBC4BF1DE29", "A tightly woven set of reinforced bandages prepared specifically for the treatment of bleeding wounds. Unlike ordinary cloth wraps, their dense construction allows firm and sustained pressure to be applied without immediately tearing or loosening. Properly secured, they can greatly reduce blood loss while a wound stabilizes, making them an essential part of any healer\'s field kit and one of the most common tools used in emergency treatment.")

column3: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "5DA33C374AFC57CF25AEE89857977621", "A compact collection of braces, bindings, and padding used to stabilize fractured bones.")
column4: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "74DFFC09418EF1BE57C286A611DF00C2", "A practical collection of rigid supports, sturdy bindings, and protective padding intended for the stabilization of broken bones. The pieces can be arranged around an injured limb to restrict movement and prevent a fracture from worsening while the body begins to recover. Though deceptively simple, a properly applied splint can make the difference between a manageable injury and lasting damage, making these kits indispensable to trained healers.")

column3: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "CAD62FAA4B67577B293680B6081DCE28", "Sturdy thread and needles suitable for closing wounds.")
column4: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "F0503A474B4B8A3DC0BB46B99B6F80E6", "A simple but indispensable set of strong thread and carefully honed needles intended for stitching torn flesh and closing wounds that will not remain sealed on their own. Proper use requires a steady hand and medical knowledge; poor stitching may cause further injury, scarring, or infection.")

column3: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "216F221D4A336AEB00298FAAA61A31B3", "A maintained set of instruments intended for surgical procedures.")
column4: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "F778DC014A2EC6A0ABEEC3B02035E0A8", "A collection of sharpened and carefully maintained instruments used for delicate medical procedures, including cutting, probing, gripping, and removing damaged tissue. In trained hands they allow work far beyond ordinary field medicine, though their use without proper knowledge can easily worsen an injury.")

column3: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "F6A3B7F6458102587F83DBACB5A61C9C", "A concentrated Yellow Lotus preparation known for altering memory, perception, and mental clarity.")
column4: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "2B6FB1D44677DAB6F440408FA9C700B9", "A potent extract distilled from Yellow Lotus and refined until only its strongest mind-altering properties remain. Consumption can distort perception, cloud recollection, and leave thoughts strangely disconnected from events that came before. Alchemists value the extract precisely because its effects reach beyond simple intoxication, making it useful wherever memory, awareness, or mental certainty must be altered. Its influence can be profound, and careless use is rarely without consequence.")

column3: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "F3366406448369D80E0D7D8DE7ACEA51", "A volatile Grey Lotus extract that drives the body toward aggression, fury, and reckless physical exertion.")
column4: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "69ECFD7F469278F4A514DC88BADF4467", "A harsh and volatile preparation distilled from Grey Lotus, notorious for the violent intensity it awakens in those who consume it. The extract floods the body with restless energy and aggression, dulling restraint while encouraging reckless exertion and rage. Warriors have occasionally sought it for the strength of its frenzy, but the same qualities that make it desirable also make it dangerous, as judgment and self-control are easily lost beneath its effects.")

column3: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "533C05B2444DA3F97CE3C2AE67111BE2", "A stimulating Crimson Lotus extract that heightens sensation, alertness, and physical sensitivity.")
column4: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "B6949C9D45B08DA8894B71853723352C", "A vivid extract refined from Crimson Lotus and prized for its powerful stimulating qualities. Once consumed, sensations sharpen and the body becomes unusually receptive to touch, sound, movement, and other physical stimuli. The effect may leave the user intensely alert and energized, though prolonged or excessive exposure can quickly become overwhelming. Herbalists and alchemists both prepare the extract, though they may do so for very different purposes.")

column3: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "30E77B1540DD74CD5869FBBFE3570B46", "A powerful Purple Lotus extract capable of weakening the body and inducing partial or complete paralysis.")
column4: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "6FDE1CD74BFC708E35A7F5ACE093DD41", "A concentrated preparation made from Purple Lotus, carrying the flower\'s debilitating properties in an especially potent form. As the extract takes hold, strength begins to fade and voluntary movement may become increasingly difficult until the body is left weak, sluggish, or entirely unresponsive. Alchemists sometimes use the substance where immobilization is required, though its narrow margin between useful sedation and dangerous paralysis demands considerable care.")

column3: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "A7EF323D44C37C5635963281EAFF522D", "A cooling Frost Lotus extract that numbs sensation, calms the body, and dulls pain.")
column4: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "7E40CF7548A189D79E64308923FB5148", "A pale extract distilled from Frost Lotus and refined for its powerful numbing and calming properties. Consumption gradually dulls physical sensation, eases pain, and produces a quieting heaviness throughout the body. In controlled quantities it can be useful during medical treatment or periods of severe discomfort, though stronger doses may leave the user sluggish and detached from their surroundings. Both herbalists and alchemists are known to prepare it.")

column3: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "D83B8B8F48CDC64839B27986AA5D0534", "A dangerous Black Lotus extract associated with delirium, madness, and profoundly unnatural altered states.")
column4: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "55E4E16841E56ACD9EA10C89D06D4DA1", "A dark and unsettling preparation distilled from Black Lotus, a flower whose reputation is tied as much to sorcery as to alchemy. Its effects can distort perception with terrifying intensity, producing delirium, hallucination, and profound changes in awareness. Some practitioners seek the extract for occult or transformative purposes, while others regard it as little more than poison wearing the guise of revelation. Even among experienced alchemists, Black Lotus is handled with considerable caution.")

column3: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "5679A41C42DAAF27D211D18F958D6FFD", "A rare Golden Lotus elixir that floods the body with extraordinary vitality, warmth, and euphoric energy.")
column4: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "F462C1BB463275A9D63C68989857C793", "A luminous and exceptionally rare elixir refined from Golden Lotus, carrying a reputation for restoring vitality with almost miraculous intensity. Those who drink it describe a surge of warmth, energy, and exhilaration spreading throughout the body, briefly making exhaustion and weakness seem distant concerns. Its scarcity and unusual potency place it among the most prized creations of accomplished alchemists, and even small quantities are treated as valuable commodities.")

column3: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "60485E9B4BEA5F875D13798CEA0BECBD", "A powerful anesthetic draught combining numbing and paralytic lotus extracts to prepare a patient for extreme medical procedures.")
column4: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "0A7174E8456C4CCB235CFA953CBCB09C", "A carefully balanced anesthetic created by combining the numbing properties of Frost Lotus with the immobilizing qualities of Purple Lotus. The resulting draught suppresses pain, quiets involuntary movement, and leaves the body sufficiently subdued for procedures that would otherwise be unbearable. Stillblossom Draught is reserved for the most serious medical work, where ordinary pain relief is insufficient and complete stillness may be essential to the patient\'s survival.")

column3: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "B1F2E72D405A84420CE5329CEB6ABBDE", "A topical Crimson Lotus resin that heightens sensitivity and intensifies sensation where it is applied.")
column4: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "BEE6EAED4A9902264D5CA38382EEE123", "A sticky resin infused with concentrated Crimson Lotus and prepared specifically for external use. When rubbed into the skin, it heightens local sensitivity and makes even subtle physical sensations feel considerably stronger. Unlike an ingested extract, the resin allows its effects to remain focused upon the area where it is applied, making it useful when an alchemist desires a controlled and localized increase in sensation rather than a full-body stimulant.")

column3: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "D43DECE040ABA3732AC1AEBD78B6AB3A", "A topical Frost Lotus resin used to numb sensation and calm discomfort in a localized area.")
column4: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "924984CC46123A48D553CFA546977C64", "A cool, pale resin infused with Frost Lotus and intended for direct application to the skin. The preparation gradually deadens sensation in the affected area, reducing pain and leaving the flesh pleasantly numb. Its localized action makes it useful when a full dose of Frost Lotus Extract would be unnecessary or undesirable, particularly during minor procedures or whenever a specific area of the body needs to be desensitized.")

column3: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "38BAEA7C44D428E6BEEFACAC0F292AA2", "A topical Purple Lotus resin that weakens muscles and can produce localized numbness or paralysis.")
column4: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "70D536CC4C36105F2AD90B9A855B1376", "A heavy resin prepared from concentrated Purple Lotus and formulated for topical use. Applied to the skin, its debilitating properties seep gradually into the underlying muscles, causing weakness, sluggish movement, and potentially localized paralysis. The effect is more focused than that of an ingested Purple Lotus Extract, allowing an experienced alchemist to target a particular area without necessarily affecting the entire body.")

column3: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "620648F34FE4091AA004718D6BB56EFE", "A powerful medicinal draught formulated to end the physical symptoms of withdrawal when properly administered.")
column4: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "93F1A2B54D991AD10F08B1BA9B2CF670", "An advanced medicinal preparation created specifically for severe cases of withdrawal. Unlike a Soothing Herbal Tonic, which merely eases discomfort while the symptoms run their course, this draught is intended to bring the withdrawal itself to an end when properly administered. Its preparation demands considerably greater pharmaceutical knowledge, making it one of the remedies that distinguishes a trained Apothecary from a simple herbalist.")

column3: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "A4005C834A60801BE6C12CB0FAA90211", "An advanced medicine prepared from a Contagion Trace and used in the treatment of Blight.")
column4: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "BE2EF3C94325568A0D49D6ADE9ADC1F1", "A complex curative preparation developed specifically for those suffering from Blight. Its creation requires a preserved Contagion Trace taken from an afflicted subject, allowing the Apothecary to prepare a remedy suited to the strange nature of the illness itself. Properly administered by a healer, the Panacea can be used to combat Blight at various stages of progression, making it one of the most valuable and specialized medicines available to the medical professions.")

column3: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "8E6456124149111C10F2E5B99C0BFCB8", "A sacred elixir used to purge corruption from the body and spirit.")
column4: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "3EC04B6F4C477B952C0BFBBA28D8DD8C", "A pale cleansing draught prepared through spiritual rites and careful alchemical practice. When consumed, it helps draw corruptive influence from the body and spirit, easing the taint left by prolonged exposure to unnatural forces. Its preparation is traditionally entrusted to Spiritualists, for the elixir relies as much on ritual purity as on the ingredients themselves.")

column3: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "67F3D3F94B4C0823C45709A3B1D38950", "A carefully preserved sample taken from a Blight-afflicted patient and used in the preparation of Plague Panacea.")
column4: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "416A56344BC267B271E5CB92C4BFDE40", "A carefully preserved sample collected from a contagious subject. Though dangerous and unsuitable for direct treatment, the material is invaluable for studying the progression of Blight and preparing remedies intended to combat its more advanced stages.")

column3: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "6B2CEB8F41A0E50EF097EC8CF844ACE4", "A common coin used for everyday trade.")
column4: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "02474BED4F0DBB72265272AB483DEAB2", "A simple, widely accepted coin that changes hands in ordinary transactions, from food and drink to common goods and services. Marks form the backbone of day-to-day commerce and are carried by merchants, travellers, and workers alike.")

column3: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "8ABC82D14ABC8E689C247FAFCDE2D0F6", "A valuable coin reserved for larger transactions.")
column4: NSLOCTEXT("[E6A463774C93B8C9A5B29796AB42FAA1]", "EA6F23894FA65BE600666CB068CF6120", "A coin of considerably greater value than the humble Mark, more often exchanged for costly goods, significant services, or substantial payments. Crowns are less commonly carried in large numbers and are a familiar measure of serious wealth.")
